pantanal.overview: The Pantanal is a vast wetland where walking is limited to short, flat trails and raised lodge roads, mostly on guided walks from lodges. These easy paths lead through gallery forests and open marshes. The best conditions for walking run from July to September when the ground is dry.

months.1: Heavy rains flood the plains, leaving only raised roads and higher ground for short strolls.
months.2: The waters are at their highest, restricting foot travel to raised roads and lodge grounds.
months.7: Dry conditions make this a good month to walk the dirt trails and raised roads.
months.12: Rising floodwaters cover the plains, limiting walking to raised roads and lodge grounds.
